stackDivergence.rationale: Task72 supplies the complete original shared include/formula/errorcodes.hxx enum and all three helper functions required by ScFormulaResult and ScFormulaCell. Original explicit published/internal cases, finite/infinite/NaN precedence and UInt16 code payload are preserved through Number.isFinite and DataView, without a second SAL union library or synthetic formula token/cell. Normal-only caller compiles the whole unchanged pinned header, verifies all seven original header dependencies and one reused configuration, and captures every65536 UInt16 error creation/decoding/publication plus300finite/infinite/quiet/signaling NaN bit witnesses. Compiler-reported SDK metadata is recorded without reading outside-repository files or claiming its bytes are pinned. Portable complete raw100 and actual Chromium production-module scalar/object/Float64 storage witnesses are required. No claim is made for other browser engines, payload preservation through arithmetic/JSON/cross-process transport, arbitrary native ABI, full formula module/upstream QA or complete Calc document/UI. Actual formula/edittext/CellStoreType/ScColumn/Table/Document/edit/undo/input/view/UI remain required. Last full71; next full81.
